summary: Masks sensitive values in error output, verifies installer downloads, writes config atomically with tighter permissions, and fixes C# union/form bodies and Terraform discriminated-union generation.
Adds `--rubygems-trusted-publishing` to configure RubyGems trusted publishing.
Adds CLI continuation primitives (omit, request-shape skips, stall guard). Also TypeScript pattern validation, Java request timeouts, a raised MCP `hono` floor, and a Terraform `const` schema change.
Adds `--nuget-trusted-publishing` to `configure publishing`, which sets NuGet OIDC trusted publishing instead of a nuget.org API key.
Keeps auto-assigned CLI flag shorthands stable across regenerations and adds `preferShorthand` pins. Python base64 file inputs now base64-encode raw bytes. Bumps staticcheck to v0.8.2 for Go 1.27.2.
Fails commands on declared terminal failure states; writes artifact `--out` paths as given; Python open-union fixes; Go collapses flat response unions that share one schema.
Adds CLI config clearing and implied flags, improves security and output in the CLI and Python, and reports SDK diffs.
Security-relevant patch: requires Go 1.26.10 for the eMudhra CA revocation and bumps jackson-databind, httpx2, express, vitest and x/net past open advisories.
CLI adds multi-field stream metadata and earlier `--jq` validation. Go SDKs add `EventStream.RawValue`; TypeScript gains MCP servers on SDK v2.
CLI adds custom pattern error messages and redacts sensitive bodies in diagnostics. Go and Terraform SDKs mask sensitive values in HTTP logs.
